title: Reacting to changing business needs for variable compensation
outcome: Third-party dependency for every plan change replaced with a flexible model
challenge: Every comp plan change meant engaging third-party service providers — slow and expensive, with the business changing faster than vendors could respond.
whatWeDid: We restructured the SPM configuration for maintainability and set up a flexible support model so plan changes ship in days, not procurement cycles.
results: Plan changes delivered without third-party lock-in
